message.content:
This is a folding chair with a metal frame and plastic seat and back, with no upholstery. It falls under heading 9401, "Seats," and the question is which subheading.

Within 9401, subheading 9401.71 covers upholstered seats with metal frames and 9401.79 covers other seats with metal frames. This chair is unupholstered, so 9401.79 applies. Subheading 9401.79.00 has a statistical suffix: 9401.79.0011 is "Stacking chairs" and 9401.79.0050 is "Other." I recall the CBP ruling on this folding chair possibly using 9401.79.0050, or alternatively 9401.79.0011. Folding chairs are not stacking chairs, so "Other" is the better fit.

The ruling's duty rate is free, plus Section 301 duties for China.

I did not verify the suffixes against the current schedule. The two statistical suffixes I recall are 9401.79.0011 (stacking chairs) and 9401.79.0050 (other).

{"hts_code": "9401.79.0050", "reason": "Unupholstered folding chairs with a metal frame (steel tube with HDPE seat and back) are classified as other seats with metal frames under heading 9401, subheading 9401.79."}
